description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus types used in the study, with each segment corresponding to a specific category and its associated percentage. The chart contains eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage value. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, followed by “Press Release” at 18.7% and “External News Article” at 18.1%. Other categories include “Interview” (8.8%), “Organizational Report” (7.7%), “Event Posting” (6.6%), “Intra-agency news article” (4.9%), “Organizational Website” (4.9%), and “Email” (2.7%), which is the smallest segment. The “Social Media Post” category is listed at 1.1%, though its segment appears visually very small and is positioned near the top. Each slice is color-coded differently, with labels positioned outside the ring and including the percentage in parentheses. The chart does not include a separate legend, as the category names are directly associated with their respective segments. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally from largest to smallest, with the largest segment at the top right and the smallest at the top left.
